role: Hindsight feasibility only, never used for training or model selection
claim: For an infeasible query no available stock can simultaneously match the best return, drawdown and shortfall among the stocks selected by reference models. This rules out per-query Top1 universal dominance on that cohort.
not_claimed: Does not prove the aggregate promotion gate impossible. Does not address diversification, different horizons or trading execution. Outcome data limitations still apply.
